podcast.body: This "menacing" song was the first single from "Facelift" and became a significant radio hit for Alice in Chains. It broke into Billboard's Album Rock Chart in spring 1991, peaking at number 18 by July 1991, and served as an important ambassador for the emerging Grunge sound and the Seattle scene. "the menacing Man in the Box."

podcast.title: Second Most Played Rock Song on Radio (2010s)
podcast.body: "Man in the Box" by Alice in Chains, released on August 27th, 1991, was the second most played rock song on rock radio during the 2010s. Its high ranking underscores the lasting impact and airwave presence of 90s grunge. "Two was men in the box from Alice in Chains."
